result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with one notable visual truncation issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis indicator, making it unclear that the text is cut off intentionally versus a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to ensure truncated text ends with '...' to signal to users that the name continues.
